author: ceval
description:
C-Eval is a comprehensive Chinese evaluation suite for foundation models. It consists of 13948 multi-choice questions spanning 52 diverse disciplines and four difficulty levels. Please visit our website and GitHub or check our paper for more details.
Each subject consists of three splits: dev, val, and test.  The dev set per subject consists of five exemplars with explanations for few-shot evaluation. The val set is intended to be used for hyperparameter tuning. And the test set is for model… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ceval/ceval-exam.
